US and India to Co-Produce Javelin Missiles

Three days after signing a deal valued at less than ₹300 crore, the United States and India have announced plans for the co-production of Javelin missiles. The Economic Times reported that Tata is involved in this co-production. Dainik Jagran specified that Tata has partnered with US companies Raytheon and Lockheed Martin for the co-production of Javelin missiles in India, framing it as a defense boost for India.
